scene: One illustrated man with swept brown hair, forehead creases, angled brows, red irises and an asymmetric white grin fills the left side. Red suit jacket and tie surround a shaded gray shirt. A broad curved black arrow above the text points left toward his hair.
mechanism: A second-person accusation attached to a villain portrait, which casts the viewer as the character.
composition: Large face and shoulders occupy the left; You Are / Pure Evil sits on the right against white. A broad curved black arrow above the text points left toward the hairline. The figure extends off the lower frame.
typography: Four words on two lines in thin hand-style black lettering, except Evil, which is red; the lines are large and readable at 160x90 though the strokes are lighter than a bold headline. The text delivers a verdict on the viewer that the title's 'ruthless' only hints at.
colors: White ground with a saturated red suit, tie and the single red word, plus a warm tan face and dark brown hair. The red is menace-coded and repeats in the irises and in Evil, while everything else is black or white.
psychology: Lowered, angled brows, red irises, a one-sided grin and a forward-tilted head read as menace, and the red clothing amplifies it. The words 'You Are' put the viewer in the role.
partnership: The title offers a role-play as a ruthless hedge fund CEO; the thumbnail escalates it to a moral verdict with a villain portrait. No hedge-fund imagery appears, so the finance setting comes only from the title.
scan: ANALYST_VISUAL_HEURISTIC: the red-suited face first, the red word Evil second, then 'You Are', with the arrow pointing back at the head.
art: Clean vector-style cartoon with consistent outlines, shading on the hair and jacket and a crisp cutout on white. Anatomy and the tie knot are coherent, while the hand-drawn arrow uses a looser line style than the polished figure.
strength: A huge menacing face and one red word make the villain role instant to read.
weakness: No finance prop appears, so the portrait could belong to any villain topic.
bottleneck: The title's finance context is missing from the image, so relevance rests on the title.
action: Hypothesis: add a stock-chart screen behind the shoulder to test whether a finance cue improves topic clarity without weakening the face.
counterexample: Seq 8 shows a relaxed figure in a warm room with a quiet label, where this frame uses a menacing close-up.
expression_label: angled brows, red irises and one-sided grin

scene: One illustrated armored man has a red-crested silver/gold helmet, furrowed brows, wide eyes and an open mouth showing teeth and tongue. Red splashes mark the face, helmet and segmented armor. A red shield with gold rim fills the lower right foreground. Above the right-side headline, a broad black curved arrow points left toward the helmet. Background is white.
mechanism: Dead Man Walking supplies a danger phrase beside an exposed expressive face; the title supplies the Roman army rank setting.
composition: The large head and armored upper body occupy the left; a foreground shield extends toward the lower center/right. Two-line headline sits on the right with arrow above. White space separates lettering from character. The helmet crest and bottom armor are close to frame edges.
typography: Three rounded handwritten words on two lines: Dead Man in red, Walking in black. All three remain readable at 320x180 and 160x90. No incidental legible lettering observed.
colors: White background separates black lettering/outlines from red crest, red headline, red shield and red splashes. Silver/gray armor with gold trim supplies secondary contrast. Facial shading is warm pink; red functions as an interpreted danger accent.
psychology: Wide eyes, furrowed brows and a large open mouth are visible facial cues. Fear, alarm or screaming are interpretations; no actual emotion or sound can be established from this still. Red splashes are observed marks, not independently proven blood.
partnership: Title promises life across every Roman army rank. Image shows one armored character and a danger phrase, adding stakes without naming any rank. Roman affiliation is supplied by the title; historical costume accuracy and an actual fatal outcome are unverified.
scan: ANALYST_VISUAL_HEURISTIC: exposed eyes/open mouth and red crest, then red Dead Man, black Walking and arrow; no eye-tracking evidence.
art: Outlined shaded cartoon figure and equipment have coherent contours and metallic highlight blocks. Mouth and armor details resolve natively; at 160x90 the head silhouette, open mouth, red crest and headline survive while smaller splashes lose definition.
strength: Large exposed expression and three readable words provide a fast danger proposition against white.
weakness: No rank is named; one distressed character does not show the promised range of army roles.
bottleneck: The image communicates danger more specifically than rank differentiation; the title carries the full historical/rank scope.
action: HYPOTHESIS: test one content-supported rank label beside the character while retaining the face and headline; check whether specificity improves recognition without crowding mobile layout.
counterexample: EvuEMhh7SSk uses the same Dead Man Walking phrase with a mask; this image exposes eyes and mouth cues. This comparison concerns visible construction, not performance causality.
expression_label: wide eyes, furrowed brows, open mouth

scene: Two illustrated human figures appear: a spiky-haired masked figure in red/black clothing leans over a pale prone figure. Long black limbs cross a white torso bearing a stitched horizontal line. The prone head has closed-looking eyes. A muted olive wall has cracks behind the red headline. No exposed organ or visible arrow is observed.
mechanism: The red K*LLED FOR PARTS headline adds an explicit lethal consequence to an illustrated body-handling scene; the title identifies organ trafficking.
composition: Masked figure fills the left edge; prone torso runs across the lower half to a large round head on the right. Two-line red headline dominates upper center/right. Black limbs cross the torso; cracked olive wall and gray table provide secondary background.
typography: PROMINENT_PACKAGE_TEXT: K*LLED FOR / PARTS, three space-separated words; the star replaces a letter. Thick red uppercase letters with black outlines remain readable at 320x180 and 160x90. INCIDENTAL_IN_SCENE_TEXT: NONE_OBSERVED.
colors: Saturated red letters and clothing contrast with muted olive wall, pale white body and cyan face covering. Thick dark contours separate objects; red operates as an interpreted danger cue. Gray marks on the prone body are not independently identified as injury or blood.
psychology: Visible cues include a downward-tilted masked face and a prone figure with closed-looking eyes. Threat and helplessness are analyst interpretations. No actual emotion, death, surgical act or medical outcome can be verified from the cartoon.
partnership: Title promises what organ trafficking is actually like. The scene and K*LLED FOR PARTS phrase supply a lethal victim framing, while no organ, transaction or broker is visibly identified. The categorical killing implication needs content verification.
scan: ANALYST_VISUAL_HEURISTIC: large red headline first, masked face and contrasting pale body second, then stitched torso line. This is a first-look interpretation without eye-tracking evidence.
art: Rough cartoon/stick-limb illustration mixes shaded hair and clothing with a simple pale face and body. Heavy outlines preserve the scene silhouette at 160x90; small stitches and wall cracks lose precision. Medical realism and anatomical accuracy are not established.
strength: Three large red words give a clear danger proposition, supported by contrasting masked and prone figures.
weakness: The scene shows no identifiable organ or trade exchange; categorical killing language may narrow a broader trafficking explanation.
bottleneck: Topic recognition depends on the title, while the most prominent claim requires content support that has not been checked.
action: HYPOTHESIS: test a content-supported transaction or organ cue with less categorical victim copy, retaining the large lettering and two-figure contrast.
mechanism_secondary: masked figure and prone-body threat framing
counterexample: 0n5xG4epnY0 uses one exposed expressive face and a danger phrase; this frame uses a masked figure and prone body. This is a construction comparison only.
expression_label: masked downward face; closed-looking eyes on prone figure
hero_object: masked figure and stitched prone torso

scene: Three illustrated figures sit shoulder-to-shoulder on white under Dealer, Sicario and Cook labels. Left figure wears a backward red cap, red hoodie and chain with drooping brows and a downturned mouth. Center figure wears a backward green cap, dark glasses, black face covering, green hoodie, dark vest and chain. Right figure wears a gray full-face respirator and yellow collared garment.
mechanism: Three named roles provide a quick taxonomy preview; contrasting clothing and face coverings differentiate roles without exposing the promised life experience.
composition: Three similarly large heads span the width. The green center figure overlaps both neighbors in front; each black role label occupies the white band above its figure. Clothing is cropped by the bottom edge, and outer figures meet side edges. No visible arrow.
typography: PROMINENT_PACKAGE_TEXT: Dealer / Sicario / Cook, three black bold mixed-case words above the figures. All remain readable at 320x180 and 160x90. INCIDENTAL_IN_SCENE_TEXT: NONE_OBSERVED.
colors: Red, green and yellow garments separate the three figures against white. Black outlines, glasses and coverings contrast strongly. Gray chains and respirator add details. Red is a clothing category cue, not a warning banner.
psychology: Drooping brows and a downturned mouth on the left suggest concern or sadness as analyst interpretations. Center eyes/mouth are covered and right face is obscured by a respirator; their emotions cannot be established.
partnership: Title supplies cartel setting, second-person life framing and every-position scope. Thumbnail previews Dealer, Sicario and Cook without showing hierarchy or lived experiences. Three examples do not independently verify the exhaustive every-position promise.
scan: ANALYST_VISUAL_HEURISTIC: overlapping green center figure, contrasting red/yellow neighbors, then the three labels. Multiple large faces compete for attention; no measured first-look or eye-tracking result.
art: Clean outlined cartoon portraits combine simple facial marks with shaded hats, clothing and detailed chains/respirator. At mobile size color blocks and masks survive, while small chain links and respirator perforations merge. Role accuracy is not independently established.
strength: Three readable role labels and distinct colors quickly communicate a set of contrasting characters.
weakness: Equal-scale portraits give no rank ordering and show only three examples of an every-position promise.
bottleneck: The category preview is clear but adds little specific tension about what life in each role involves.
action: HYPOTHESIS: test a content-supported role contrast or risk cue beside the center figure while retaining the readable labels.
counterexample: 3MrJIFKO-94 foregrounds a lethal consequence; this image previews a role taxonomy without explicit danger copy. Construction differs; no performance cause is inferred.
expression_label: left drooping brows/downturned mouth; center and right faces obscured

scene: Large red THE END headline sits above a black embedded channel-header panel. Panel reads The Wealth Explainer with a checkmark, handle, subscriber/video counts, a short description and Subscribed, Join, Community controls. Circular avatar shows a simple smiling face and green shirt. A thin curved black arrow points down toward the panel on white.
mechanism: Finality headline and channel identity create a closure question for viewers familiar with the name. The screenshot-like panel supplies recognition rather than a substantive reason for closure.
composition: Red headline is centered across the upper portion; wide black header panel occupies the middle/lower area with circular avatar left and channel identity right. Thin arrow at upper right points down to the panel. White margins isolate both blocks.
typography: PROMINENT_PACKAGE_TEXT: THE END, two large red uppercase words readable at 160x90. INCIDENTAL_IN_SCENE_TEXT native: The Wealth Explainer; @WealthExplainerYT; 274K subscribers; 29 videos; thank you for watching :) ...more; Subscribed; Join; Community. Channel name is readable at 320x180 but PARTIALLY_READABLE at 160x90; remaining small panel text is TEXT_PRESENT_BUT_NOT_VERIFIABLE at 160x90. Incidental copy is excluded from headline word count.
colors: White ground isolates saturated red headline and black embedded panel. White/gray panel lettering and pale avatar contrast against black; a green collar is a small accent. Red suggests finality or alarm as interpretation, not a verified outcome.
psychology: Avatar shows dot eyes, small brows and an upturned mouth, suggesting a friendly smile. Its calm appearance contrasts with THE END framing. Actual creator emotion and channel fate are not observable from the embedded panel.
partnership: Title says The Wealth Explainer is DEAD; headline says THE END and panel names the same channel. Both communicate closure, while neither explains why or what comes next. Embedded subscriber/video counts are depicted interface text, not independently verified current metrics.
scan: ANALYST_VISUAL_HEURISTIC: red THE END first, bright avatar and channel name second, then curved arrow and small interface details. Familiarity may change this order; no measured attention evidence.
art: Mixed typography, embedded interface panel and cartoon avatar. Large clean red letters and a sharp rectangular panel contrast with the avatar sketch. At mobile size headline survives but the interface details and full channel name become much harder to resolve.
strength: Two-word finality headline stays legible and the embedded channel identity can cue existing audience recognition.
weakness: The title and headline repeat finality without offering a reason; most identifying panel detail becomes small on mobile.
bottleneck: Interest relies heavily on familiarity with the channel and unanswered reason for closure, limiting standalone topic specificity.
action: HYPOTHESIS: test a content-supported reason or replacement cue in place of duplicated finality wording while enlarging the channel identity.
counterexample: 5IdPdw62oT0 uses three readable role labels to preview content; this frame announces closure without explaining a cause. No performance causality is inferred.
hero_object: channel identity panel under THE END

scene: Illustrated spiky-haired figure in a brown coat and tan scarf occupies the right foreground, with wide outlined eyes and blue sweat/stress marks. White YOU lettering sits lower left-center; curved white arrow points toward the figure. Orange/yellow mushroom-shaped explosion fills the left skyline above damaged-looking buildings. A black radiation-style trefoil appears on a yellow wall sign at upper right; black/yellow stripes run along the foreground edge.
mechanism: The YOU label and pointing arrow cast the viewer into a threatened character role, while the mushroom-cloud shape and radiation-style sign frame nuclear danger.
composition: Large character head on right balances bright mushroom-shaped cloud on left. Skyline and ruined-looking walls occupy the lower background. White YOU has a heavy black outline near lower left-center, with a curved arrow above it pointing right. Radiation-style sign is partly cropped at right.
typography: PROMINENT_PACKAGE_TEXT: YOU, one large white uppercase word with thick black outline, readable at native, 320x180 and 160x90. INCIDENTAL_IN_SCENE_TEXT: NONE_OBSERVED. The radiation-style icon is a symbol, not a word.
colors: Orange/yellow explosion and sky dominate against dark building silhouettes and brown clothing. White lettering and face contrast sharply; blue facial marks supply a cooler accent. Yellow/black sign and stripes are interpreted hazard cues, not evidence of actual radiation.
psychology: Wide eyes, small straight/slanted mouth and blue cheek/forehead marks suggest alarm or worry as analyst interpretations. Character faces left toward the bright cloud. Actual emotions, exposure and outcome cannot be established from the still.
partnership: Title specifies the first 24 hours of World War 3. Image adds YOU role framing and a nuclear-disaster interpretation, but names no belligerent or trigger and shows no hour sequence. Actual future events and content coverage are unverified.
scan: ANALYST_VISUAL_HEURISTIC: bright cloud and pale character face compete first, then outlined YOU and arrow, then hazard icon. No measured gaze order; detailed skyline texture becomes secondary at mobile size.
art: Outlined cartoon combines a simple character face and stick-like limbs with layered explosion shapes and shaded urban rubble. Native details include cloud contours and facial marks; at 160x90 cloud silhouette, face and YOU remain distinct while rubble texture compresses.
strength: A one-word viewer cue, large expressive face and bright disaster silhouette create an immediate personal-stakes scenario.
weakness: Visual nuclear framing is narrower than a general world-war title and may imply a scenario not established by the unreviewed content.
bottleneck: The package communicates personal nuclear danger clearly but leaves the trigger and first-day sequence entirely to the title/content.
action: HYPOTHESIS: test a content-supported first-hour or trigger cue while retaining the large face and YOU label; avoid presenting a hypothetical war as a confirmed forecast.
counterexample: 6k6QjHtRHYk pairs finality copy with a channel panel; this frame uses a viewer character inside a disaster scene. Visual construction only, not a causal performance claim.
expression_label: wide eyes, blue sweat/stress marks, small mouth

scene: Stick-limbed cartoon figure in a brown fur tunic with a belt and spiky black hair stands left, leaning back with a long spear pointed toward a woolly-mammoth-like animal on the right. The animal has curved white tusks and glowing red eyes and charges through snow, with ice shards flying around its feet. Snowy mountains and blue sky form the background. Large red YOU with black outline sits top-left with a thin red curved arrow pointing at the figure's head. Figure's hand and foot are cropped at the left and bottom edges.
mechanism: YOU and the arrow assign the viewer to the spear-holding figure, while the charging red-eyed mammoth-like animal supplies an immediate survival threat.
composition: Figure on the left and large animal on the right face each other across a diagonal spear. The animal's head and tusks fill the upper right and its red eyes sit near the top-right third. YOU occupies the top-left corner above the figure, with the arrow bridging text to character. Snowy ground and mountains stay low-contrast behind the subjects.
typography: PROMINENT_PACKAGE_TEXT: YOU, one large red uppercase word with thick black outline, readable at native, 320x180 and 160x90. INCIDENTAL_IN_SCENE_TEXT: NONE_OBSERVED. The red arrow is a pointer, not a word; it thins at 160x90 but YOU still identifies the figure.
colors: Saturated blue sky and white snow dominate the background, giving strong separation for the brown animal and fur tunic. Red appears only in YOU, the arrow and the animal's eyes, linking viewer label to threat. Black outlines and black hair/limbs keep the figure legible against snow.
psychology: Glowing red eyes, a lowered head and flying ice suggest a charging threat as analyst interpretations; the figure's small frowning face suggests tension or resolve but is minimal. Actual danger, outcome and content depiction cannot be established from the still.
partnership: Title says POV: You're a Prehistoric Human. Image repeats YOU, then makes the era concrete through fur clothing, a spear, ice-age scenery and a mammoth-like animal, and implies a hunting or survival encounter. It names no time period and the title does not mention an animal; actual content coverage is unverified.
scan: ANALYST_VISUAL_HEURISTIC: bright red YOU and the large red-eyed animal head compete first, then the arrow and small figure. No measured gaze order; at mobile size the animal silhouette and YOU remain distinct while ice-shard detail and the thin arrow compress.
art: Flat outlined cartoon: stick-limbed figure with a textured fur tunic beside a more detailed, shaded mammoth-like animal. Native details include tusk highlights, fur strokes and individual ice shards; at 160x90 the mammoth silhouette, blue/white palette and YOU survive while shard detail disappears.
strength: A single bold viewer cue plus a large threatening animal makes a survival-scenario proposition readable almost instantly at phone size.
weakness: The figure is small and expressionless relative to the animal, so the personal-stakes emotion is carried by the label and arrow rather than the face; the confrontation scenario may be narrower than a general prehistoric-life title.
bottleneck: The image communicates a survival encounter clearly but not which prehistoric period or what the viewer will learn; that remains title and content work.
action: HYPOTHESIS: test a content-supported era or time cue and a more expressive character face while keeping the red YOU label and the animal as the dominant threat; avoid implying the video is only a mammoth hunt unless content supports it.
mechanism_secondary: second-person role framing with visible threat
counterexample: 7KEqvaL0nwg uses the same YOU-label-and-arrow device inside an illustrated disaster scene; this video's public age-matched class is LOW while that one is MIDDLE. Visual construction only, not a causal performance claim.
hero_object: charging mammoth-like animal and spear-holding viewer figure
